name: show_proposal
description: Show the proposal card. Payload: {sector, problem, title (max 8 words), steps [3, each max 12 words], hoursSavedPerWeek (integer), confidence ('baja'|'media'|'alta')}.

name: update_proposal
description: Change part of the proposal card already shown. Payload: any subset of the show_proposal fields; only the fields sent are replaced.

name: highlight_step
description: Highlight one step of the proposal while explaining it. Payload: {index: 0 | 1 | 2}.

name: clear_ui
description: Remove the proposal card and reset the page to its initial state. Payload: {}.

name: sector_selected
description: The user picked a business sector on the page. Payload: {sector: string}. Acknowledge the sector and ask what problem takes up their time.

name: ui_sync
description: Full current page state; treat the latest one as ground truth. Payload: {status ('idle'|'listening'|'proposal'|'done'), sector, problem, title, steps, hoursSavedPerWeek, confidence, highlightedStep}.
